PZZ700-270830-
1204 PM PST Thu Nov 26 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 12 noon, a 1026 mb high was 600 nautical miles west of San
Diego. Combined seas of 6-9 feet will continue to lower across the
outer waters this evening. Weak to moderate onshore flow today 
will be replaced by weak offshore flow Friday and Saturday. 
Stronger onshore flow returns Sunday. A Pacific storm system will
near the area around next Tuesday, which may bring increased risk
of gusty winds and high seas.
